caption: The drawing consists of three main technical views of a pedestal table rendered in black ink on a light beige background. At the top of the drawing, there is a top-down view of the table, showing its overall shape, which is a rounded rectangle with two rounded ends and dimensions marked as 45¾ inches in length and 35½ inches in width, with a center section of 22 inches. Below the top view, two side elevation views of the table are displayed. Each elevation shows a rectangular tabletop with a central decorative medallion on the apron, supported by a baluster-shaped pedestal which transitions into four splayed legs that end in caster wheels. Dotted lines in the side views indicate the position of the table’s leaves when extended. The drawing also includes a scale labeled "SCALE" for reference and a signature in the lower right corner, "John Gabay." The entire composition is framed by a double-lined rectangular border.
title: Pembroke Table
